name: Task Planning Agent SOUL.md
useCase: Define a planning agent that creates task files without talking to the user.
templateContent: You are the Task Planning Agent. Read the blueprint, constraints, and planning brief. Create task files, dependencies, blockers, and user-action recommendations. Do not edit master control files.
setupNotes: Place in the agent profile file
Test with a sample planning brief
exampleUsage: Use before implementation starts to create scoped task files.

name: Command Center Folder Template
useCase: Create the file-based memory and control structure for agent work.
exampleUsage: Start a new navigation-site build with persistent task memory.

name: Affiliate Target Tracker
useCase: Track affiliate program targets, status, target pages, and next actions.
templateContent: toolName, slug, category, status, publicUrl, affiliateUrl, targetPages, disclosureRequired, nextAction
setupNotes: Only mark active with approved URL
Map every tool to commercial pages
safetyNotes: Keep credential handling out of tracker
exampleUsage: Track whether Make or Zapier is ready for comparison page CTAs.

name: SEO Brief Template
useCase: Prepare a page brief before writing a skill, comparison, workflow, or playbook page.
templateContent: Target keyword; search intent; reader problem; source notes; recommended structure; internal links; monetization angle; unsupported claims to avoid.
setupNotes: Attach source URLs for commercial claims
safetyNotes: Do not use the brief as proof of hands-on testing
exampleUsage: Create a brief for an OpenClaw vs Make comparison page before drafting the final verdict.
targetKeyword: SEO brief template for AI content

name: Research Result Template
useCase: Capture source-backed research from a research agent before writing or implementation begins.
templateContent: Question; short answer; source list; findings; confidence; open risks; recommended next action.
setupNotes: Use one file per research task
Keep source URLs close to claims
safetyNotes: Do not summarize paywalled or inaccessible claims as verified
Flag uncertainty rather than smoothing it over
exampleUsage: Record public affiliate program requirements for Make, n8n, Railway, Airtable, and Semrush.

name: Writing Result Template
useCase: Record what a writing agent changed, what claims need QA, and what still requires evidence.
templateContent: Summary; files changed; sections drafted; claims added; missing evidence; status.
setupNotes: Write after the draft is complete
safetyNotes: Do not mark hands-on content complete without evidence
Do not hide missing source work
exampleUsage: Summarize a new playbook outline and note that it is not a completed hands-on tutorial.

name: QA Checklist
useCase: Review implementation or content before a task is marked done.
templateContent: Acceptance criteria; testing evidence; unsupported claims; disclosure; SEO basics; residual risk; final status.
setupNotes: Record residual risks even when passing
safetyNotes: Commercial claims need source or hands-on support
exampleUsage: Check that an affiliate comparison does not claim approved links before approval exists.

name: Testing Result Template
useCase: Record commands, route checks, deployment checks, and pass/fail status.
templateContent: Commands run; environment; result; route checks; deployment ID; failures; final testing status.
safetyNotes: Do not mark tests passing if a required check was skipped
Include failed commands verbatim enough to reproduce
exampleUsage: Record npm lint, typecheck, build, Vercel deploy, and production route status.

name: Support Reply Prompt
useCase: Draft a support reply with tone, escalation, and human-approval boundaries.
templateContent: Given the customer message, summarize the issue, classify sensitivity, draft a reply, and list anything requiring human approval before sending.
setupNotes: Keep account details out unless approved
safetyNotes: Do not promise refunds, legal outcomes, or account changes without approval
exampleUsage: Draft a troubleshooting reply for a setup failure while flagging refund language for human review.

name: Lead Research Checklist
useCase: Research a prospect before outreach while avoiding invented personalization.
templateContent: Company; target buyer; public trigger; fit score; relevant pain; source URLs; outreach angle; missing facts.
exampleUsage: Prepare a prospect brief before a founder sends a personalized outreach email.

name: Deployment Smoke Test Checklist
useCase: Verify a production deployment before a task is marked complete.
templateContent: Deployment URL; deployment ID; homepage status; critical route statuses; sitemap; robots; expected text; final PASS/FAIL.
setupNotes: Record aliases separately from preview URLs
safetyNotes: Do not rely on build success alone
Check production alias, not only preview URL
exampleUsage: Verify homepage, sitemap, robots, and new playbook routes after a Vercel deployment.

name: Agent SOUL.md Generator Prompt
useCase: Generate a complete SOUL.md file for a new AI agent role with proper boundaries and capabilities.
templateContent: Create a SOUL.md file for an AI agent with: role definition, allowed actions, file restrictions, communication rules, and safety boundaries. Include specific file paths and command restrictions.
safetyNotes: Never allow master control file edits
exampleUsage: Generate SOUL.md for a content writing agent that can edit pages but not deploy.

name: Content Calendar Template
useCase: Plan and track content creation across multiple channels and timeframes.
templateContent: Date; content type; topic; target keyword; platform; status; assigned agent; due date; notes.
exampleUsage: Plan monthly blog posts, social media content, and email newsletters.

name: Social Media Post Template
useCase: Create engaging social media posts with hooks, content, and calls-to-action.
templateContent: Hook; main content; value proposition; call-to-action; hashtags; timing notes.
exampleUsage: Create LinkedIn posts about AI automation for small businesses.

name: Email Sequence Template
useCase: Design multi-email sequences for lead nurturing, onboarding, or product launches.
templateContent: Sequence name; trigger; email 1 subject/content; email 2 subject/content; email 3 subject/content; timing; goals.
exampleUsage: Create a 5-email welcome sequence for new subscribers.

name: Customer Onboarding Checklist
useCase: Ensure new customers have successful first experiences and achieve quick wins.
templateContent: Welcome email; account setup; first training; check-in call; quick win milestone; feedback survey.
exampleUsage: Onboard SaaS customers through initial setup and first value delivery.
